title: Verify no synchronous fs or process calls inside async console handlers
description: Acceptance line of kbs-29c415: add a CI check (clippy lint configuration or a grep-based tool in tools/) that fails when rust/src/bin/console_local.rs or kanbus::console_backend handlers call std::fs, std::process or other blocking I/O outside spawn_blocking, and fix any hits.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Done: PR #538 merged with CI green. Fixed blocking calls in async console handlers (static assets, telemetry append, multi-tenant resolve_store read_dir); tools/check_console_blocking_io.py runs in the CI rust job and fails on blocking calls in async code outside spawn_blocking/run_blocking (16 tests; rule documented in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md).
